name: claudeconnect
notes: Search in Files: the magnifier (or Ctrl+F, ⌘F on a Mac) searches the open folder and every folder in it by name, as you type, with filters for the kind of file, when it last changed and its size. A result opens in the preview, and its folder button shows where it is. Your computer reads the folder once and keeps the names for a moment, so each letter after the first is answered straight away.
Remote on a phone: turn it sideways and Remote fills the whole screen, with small keyboard and close buttons on top.
Remote can no longer be opened in a browser on the computer it shows, where it would show itself inside itself and move the mouse out from under you. It says to use another device instead.
Remote on Windows now shows the mouse pointer in the picture, and its helper is checked in PowerShell on every change.
